title: Easy Garlic Parmesan Sheet Pan Chicken Dinner
contentHtml:
One pan, normal ingredients, and dinner for the family without turning the kitchen into a disaster. This garlic Parmesan chicken with potatoes and green beans is a simple weeknight meal made for busy dads, husbands, and anyone else on dinner duty.

Servings: 6 | Prep: 15 minutes | Cook: 40 minutes

Ingredients

  • 3 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs
  • 2 pounds baby potatoes, halved
  • 1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed
  • 4 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
  • 6 cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 teaspoons paprika
  • 2 teaspoons Italian seasoning
  • 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt
  • 1 teaspoon black pepper
  • 1 teaspoon onion powder
  • 1 lemon, cut into wedges

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
  2. Toss potatoes with 1 tablespoon olive oil and some of the seasoning. Roast for 10 minutes.
  3. Coat chicken with 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic, Parmesan, and most of the remaining seasoning. Add it to the pan and roast for 20 minutes.
  4. Toss green beans with the remaining olive oil and seasoning. Add them to the pan and roast another 10-15 minutes, until the chicken reaches at least 165 degrees F and the potatoes are tender.
  5. Finish with fresh lemon and extra Parmesan if desired.

Dad-Proof Tips

Do not crowd the pan, cut larger potatoes into roughly 1-inch pieces, and use an instant-read thermometer instead of guessing when the chicken is done.

Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator for 3-4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer for the best texture.
